description: This PHP source file defines a console command class 'DeleteDatabaseSavepointCommand' used to delete a specific database savepoint in the OrangeHRM automation framework. It extends a base command class, sets a command name and description, and implements execution logic to delete a savepoint via the DatabaseBackupService.
